summary: The root كظم (kzhm) primarily means to repress or restrain, especially one's wrath or rage. It implies holding back or suppressing something, often an emotion.
lane: 1 كَظَمَ غَيْظَهُ ذ He repressed, or restrained, his wrath, or rage. (K.) -b2- كَظَمَ , aor. كَظِمَ , inf. n. كَظْمٌ , He restrained himself. (TA.) -b3- مَا يَكْظِمُ عَلَى جِرَّةٍ ; and لَا يَكْظِمٌ عَلَى جِرَّتِهِ : see جِرَّةٌ . -b4- كَظَمَ عَلَى غَيْظِهِ i. q. كَظَمَ غَيْظَهُ . (TA.)

headwords.def: كَظَمَ غَيْظَهُ He repressed, or restrained, his wrath, or rage. (K.) كَظَمَ, aor. كَظِمَ, inf. n. كَظْمٌ, He restrained himself. (TA.) مَا يَكْظِمُ عَلَى جِرَّةٍ; and لَا يَكْظِمٌ عَلَى جِرَّتِهِ: see جِرَّةٌ. كَظَمَ عَلَى غَيْظِهِ i. q. كَظَمَ غَيْظَهُ. (TA.)
[pl. of كِظَامَةٌ ] Subterranean conduits for water. (TA in art. قنو.)

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
